title: Bound under a function update
statement: Let $f:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$ and $B,v\in\mathbb Z$. If $|f(y)|\le B$ for every $y\in\mathbb N$ and $|v|\le B$, then replacing the value of $f$ at any $x\in\mathbb N$ by $v$ leaves every value bounded in absolute value by $B$.
